RDWR.title: Radware Finds Bad Bots Account for 43% of Holiday Shopping Traffic, Nearly Matching Human Shoppers
RDWR.summary: Radware's 2026 E-Commerce Bot Threat Report reveals that malicious bots accounted for 43% of e-commerce traffic during the 2025 holiday season, up from 31% a year earlier, nearly matching the 46% from human shoppers. Traditional attack techniques including account takeovers, carding, and fake registrations intensified significantly, with some attacks increasing by orders of magnitude.

SNY.summary: The European Commission has approved Sanofi's Cenrifki (tolebrutinib), a brain-penetrating Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitor, for treating secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (SPMS) without relapses. The approval is based on the Phase 3 HERCULES trial, which demonstrated that Cenrifki significantly delayed disability progression. The drug will be commercially available in Germany this year, with careful risk management protocols due to identified hepatic safety concerns.
